title: Budget the candidate stage before sizing it
description: Choose a workload and vector representation, then change candidate depth and the latency target. The model recomputes index memory, shard copies, serving capacity, and per-query pressure together.

storageProfiles.label: Float32 vectors
storageProfiles.detail: Largest memory footprint; useful as a quality reference
storageProfiles.qualityNote: Float32 is a reference representation, not a guarantee of better task relevance.

storageProfiles.label: Int8 scalar quantization
storageProfiles.detail: Smaller payload with a quality trade-off to measure
storageProfiles.qualityNote: Quantization is acceptable only when recall and ranking metrics stay inside the release gate.

storageProfiles.label: Product-quantized vectors
storageProfiles.detail: Compact serving profile; reranking becomes more important
storageProfiles.qualityNote: Aggressive compression saves memory but may require deeper retrieval or exact-vector reranking to recover quality.
